listeners.description: List of listening endpoints. Each item specifies 'type' ('unix' or 'tcp'), and either 'path' (for Unix sockets) or 'host' and 'port' (for TCP).

path.description: Path to Unix domain socket (used when type=unix)

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (used when type=tcp)

port.description: TCP port to bind to (used when type=tcp)

max_backlog.description: Maximum number of pending connections queued per listener socket.

num_workers.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 0 to auto-detect (recommended for most deployments).

max_reqs_per_worker.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests handled per worker process.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for log messages (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg).

log_dest.description: Destination for log output: 'syslog', 'stderr', or a writable file path.

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds for client connections. Connections inactive longer than this will be dropped.

enable_stats.description: Enable or disable the internal statistics HTTP endpoint.

stats_host.description: Bind address for the stats endpoint (only used when Stats is on).

stats_port.description: Port for the stats endpoint (only used when Stats is on).

unix_socket_perms.description: Unix file permissions (in octal) for the main socket file (if using Unix sockets).

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed client networks in CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8). If empty, all clients are allowed.

items.description: Allowed IPv4 network or host in CIDR or dotted-decimal notation.

pid_file.description: Optional path to PID lock file for process control.
